description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the great quarry at its grandest: a deep terraced cut in white marble rock held by a grey stone retaining wall, a tall timber crane with an iron gear wheel lifting a white block, a stone ramp, wooden scaffolding and long rows of neatly stacked cut white stone blocks

references.usage: the previous, third stage of this same building in the camp, chosen by the author: keep its idea, colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw its fourth, grandest stage, rebuilt for the stronghold with grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron
